senses.gloss: , Poël סוֹבַר (cmp. סבל) [to encompass,] to carry; to bear, endure; to sustain.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 21:15">Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 30:21">Targ. Prov. XXX, 21</cite> <he>לסוֹבָרָא</he> Ms. (ed. <he>למִסְבְּרָא</he>, <he>למְסַבְרָא</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 96:8">Targ. Ps. XCVI, 8</cite> <he>אובילו וסוֹבְרוּ</he> ed. Wil. (ed. Lag. <he>תוברו ושׂוֹבְרוּ</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 4:7">Targ. I Kings IV, 7</cite> (h. text <he>כלכל</he>); a. fr.—Y. B. Bath. II, beg. 13ᵇ <he>ולא הוה יכיל מְסוֹבָר</he> and could not carry it (and dropped it).
